# Wednesday Technology

> Full-service software engineering & IT services agency (wednesday.technology).
> We build custom software and we run it: design, development, launch and 24/7
> managed operations. Rates are published on the site — no quote-gating.

## Key facts

- Services: custom web development, iOS & Android apps, AI automation & agentic
  systems, B2B/e-commerce portals, digital experience & branding, managed
  operations & hosting, ISO 27001 & SOC 2 compliance (delivered by a certified
  ISO 27001:2022 Lead Auditor).
- Published rates (INR, excl. GST): websites from ₹18,000; business website
  ₹85,000; e-commerce ₹1,75,000; business web app ₹4,50,000; Android app
  ₹2,50,000; managed operations from ₹1,500/month; ISO 27001 health-check
  ₹35,000; ISO 27001 implementation from ₹3,50,000.
- Commercial terms: 50% advance, fixed written scope, balance on delivery,
  15-day payment terms. International clients quoted in USD.
- Typical build: written spec → small reversible steps → independent review →
  live verification → ongoing 24/7 operations. Starter one-pager in 3 working
  days; typical custom build ~6 weeks.
- In-house products: Slate (school operating system SaaS) and Blackfyre
  (open-source multi-cloud compliance platform, Apache-2.0).
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 96554 19510 · hello@wednesday.technology
